tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Describe the Merchant Context service, price, and inspection checks.

tools.name: check_merchant
tools.description: Run a free merchant-site diagnostic. Agents should use resolve_merchant before relying on merchant facts or actions.

tools.name: resolve_merchant
tools.description: Resolve cached merchant identity, sourced facts, offers, terms, freshness, and safe actions for free. Call this before relying on merchant facts or starting an action.

tools.name: search_merchants
tools.description: Search cached merchant records by sourced offer, place, price, timing, policy, action support, and freshness. Payment and adoption never change order.

tools.name: compare_offers
tools.description: Compare only sourced offer fields from two or more merchants. Unknown values stay unknown and payment never changes order.

tools.name: get_safe_actions
tools.description: Return current merchant-owned action URLs, exact inputs, authority, confirmation, expiry, retry rules, recovery, and attribution.

tools.name: preflight
tools.description: Resolve one merchant, evaluate sourced intent constraints, select a safe action, state approval, and return attribution.

tools.name: refresh_merchant
tools.description: Pay for a fresh merchant inspection and cache refresh. Show the price and get explicit human approval first.

tools.name: inspect_merchant
tools.description: Compatibility alias for refresh_merchant. Show the price and get explicit human approval first.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_merchant" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return a free readiness score and pass/fail checks for one public HTTPS merchant origin. Use inspect_merchant for detailed resource evidence." → after: "Run a free merchant-site diagnostic. Agents should use resolve_merchant before relying on merchant facts or actions."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "inspect_merchant" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Inspect one public HTTPS merchant origin for agent discovery and commerce files." → after: "Compatibility alias for refresh_merchant. Show the price and get explicit human approval first."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
